text:
[Council File 26-1200-S61]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the appointment of Adelina Camilla McCloud to the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles Board of Commissioners for the term ending June 30, 2031.
Recommendation for Council action:
RESOLVE that the Mayor’s appointment of Adelina Camilla McCloud to the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles Board of Commissioners, for the term ending June 30, 2031, is APPROVED and CONFIRMED. The appointee resides in Council District Fifteen. (Current composition: M=3; F=3; Vacant=1)
Background check Pending.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
